about: How the Census 2025 government listing meets the Census population file's incorporated places where the listing's own place code does not. A unit the listing carries without a place geoid but whose name is one place's (the city of Easthampton is listed as 'City of Easthampton Town') takes that place's geoid. An incorporated place with no unit is named here with its reason, so the test over every incorporated place has no unexplained gap.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Government Units Survey listing and Vintage 2025 population estimates (data/research/places/roadmap-r11-population-v2025-*.csv)
